articles.title: Alcobev major Diageo launches initiatives to rejuvenate Godavari, Yamuna river basins
articles.summary: Alcobev major Diageo has launched initiatives to rejuvenate India's vital Godavari and Yamuna river basins. These efforts are part of its broader water replenishment and WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene) programs. This corporate social responsibility project aims to improve water resources and hygiene for communities, contributing to national environmental sustainability and public health.

articles.title: https://github.com/schlarpc/elgato-cam-link-4k-firmware-re/tree/main
articles.summary: This repository documents the firmware and update protocol for the Elgato Cam Link 4K HDMI capture device. It also introduces 'cl4k-fwtool,' an independent utility designed to read, compare, and write the device's firmware. This initiative provides technical insight into the hardware's internal workings, allowing users or developers to manage and update the device's software independently, enhancing control over this specific video capture technology.
